page.layout: One block of text in a decorative woodcut border, one column, with the running head and page number above it. No marginal notes. The left margin shows only the edge of the facing page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: cit Alchymia, non sit frigore constitu- tum,ut pyrotechnia docet, sane dicimus frigus non esse proprie rerum generativum, sed potius calorem. Ac metalla igni ex- empta frigore consistunt, id quod & chy- mico auro non minus convenit, ut ipsa fusio docet, atqz idem naturali auro com- petit, quod usu facile perdifces. Super- est una quaestio, partim Physica, partim Theologica, an aurum per artem produ- ctu, sit verum ac naturale, & omnes pro- prietates auri naturalis tam in Medici- na, quam in caeteris rebus retineat, & si hoc non, an sit illicitum, & ordini crea- tionis contrarium. Negativam tuetur Pererius capite 19. supra citato loco: Au-rum, inquit, quod fit ab Alchymistis, licet similimum videatur vero auro, falsum tamen esse multis modis co-gnosci & judicari potest; nempe vel expondere, vel ex eo, quia non sustinet vim ignis, vel ex eo, quia injectum in urinam amittit colorem suum; vel quia non est ductile in tenuissimas la-minas;

page.notes: Show-through and the cropped edge of the facing page at the left are not transcribed. "ductū" is read from a worn abbreviation and is doubtful; "atqz" is read as printed with its abbreviation mark. The ornamental border is not text.
